mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet-activating factor and has anticoagulant properties, which combined with amitriptyline's anticholinergic effects and potential bleeding risk, increases bleeding tendency; additive CNS depression may also occur.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding (bruising, bleeding gums, hematuria) and excessive sedation; counsel patient to report any unusual bleeding; consider alternative herbal supplements if bleeding risk is a concern.
